name: envelope
description: Add an agent to your email. Don't change your email. Envelope connects to the mailbox you already use — same address, same folders, same habits — so agents can read OTPs, handle replies, run rules, and draft for approval.

ENVELOPE_AGENT_TOKEN.title: Envelope agent token
ENVELOPE_AGENT_TOKEN.description: Bearer token from `envelope agent create <name>`. Printed once at creation. Required for MCP startup; never commit the value.
